entries.title: Psalms 108:1
segments: ¶<<A Song. A Psalm of David.>> O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

entries.title: Psalms 108:2
segments: Awake, lute and harp! I will awaken the dawn.

entries.title: Psalms 108:3
segments: I will praise You, O LORD, among the peoples, And I will sing praises to You among the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 108:4
segments: For Your mercy [is] great above the heavens, And Your truth [reaches] to the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 108:5
segments: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens, And Your glory above all the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 108:6
segments: ¶That Your beloved may be delivered, Save [with] Your right hand, and hear me.

entries.title: Psalms 108:7
segments: God has spoken in His holiness: "I will rejoice; I will divide Shechem And measure out the Valley of Succoth.

entries.title: Psalms 108:8
segments: Gilead [is] Mine; Manasseh [is] Mine; Ephraim also [is] the helmet for My head; Judah [is] My lawgiver.

entries.title: Psalms 108:9
segments: Moab [is] My washpot; Over Edom I will cast My shoe; Over Philistia I will triumph."

entries.title: Psalms 108:10
segments: Who will bring me [into] the strong city? Who will lead me to Edom?

entries.title: Psalms 108:11
segments: [Is it] not [You], O God, [who] cast us off? And [You], O God, [who] did not go out with our armies?

entries.title: Psalms 108:12
segments: Give us help from trouble, For the help of man is useless.

entries.title: Psalms 108:13
segments: Through God we will do valiantly, For [it is] He [who] shall tread down our enemies.
